name: happy-path
description: The runbook and the integrated Test's first run: Lívia asks to pay order #2001 (specialty coffee 250 g, R$ 18,00) by Pix; the agent reads the order and says what it will charge; she confirms; the store approves (human) or the policy covers it (mandate); one Pix charge of R$ 18,00, due today, is issued with an idempotency key, the QR and the copia-e-cola are shown, the payer pays, the agent says 'pagamento recebido, pedido quitado'. On the simulator the stub rail issues and the stub payer pays; hosted on codespar-test the charge is a platform receive proposal the person sends, the platform issues at the provider's sandbox and its Test payer pays. Same trail in both modes.

turns.input: oi, sou a Lívia, quero pagar o pedido 2001 no Pix
